incidente.resumo: An internal Google service managing a large number of GCP projects malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API, causing global throttling under Filestore's global API request limit; all read-only API requests (List, GetOperation, etc.) failed with error 429 for customers in all locations for 3 hours 12 minutes, while mutate operations still succeeded. The issue was resolved after engineers shut down the internal service.

descricao.texto: Engineers were alerted of the issue through automated alerts on 13 September 2022 at 07:47 US/Pacific; ListInstances API requests were failing with error code 429.
trechos: Our engineers were alerted of the issue through automated alerts on Tuesday, 13 September 2022 07:47 US/Pacific.
On Tuesday, 13 September 2022 from 07:30 to 10:42 US/Pacific, Google Cloud Filestore experienced an issue where ListInstances API requests failed with error code 429.

gatilho.texto: An internal Google service managing a large number of GCP projects malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API with requests.
trechos: The outage was triggered when an internal Google service managing a large number of GCP projects malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API with requests, causing global throttling of the Filestore API.

descricao.texto: Filestore enforces a global limit on API requests; the overload caused global throttling of the Filestore API, and because the quota is global, read-only API access was unavailable for all customers in all locations.
trechos: Filestore enforces a global limit on API requests to limit impact in overload scenarios.

The outage was triggered when an internal Google service managing a large number of GCP projects malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API with requests, causing global throttling of the Filestore API.
As a result of this throttling, read-only API access was unavailable for all customers.
This affected customers in all locations, due to a global quota that applies to Filestore.

passos.texto: Once the nature and scope of the issue became clear, engineers started shutting down the internal service overloading the APIs at 10:33, and the issue was completely resolved at 10:42.
trechos: Once the nature and scope of the issue became clear, Google engineers started shutting down the internal service overloading our APIs at 10:33 and the issue was completely resolved at 10:42.
**Summary:** On Tuesday, 13 September 2022 07:30 US/Pacific, an issue with Google Cloud Filestore resulted in all read-only API requests failing for a period of 3 hours, 12 minutes.

observacoes: The final incident report announces action items ('Google is committed to preventing recurrence by implementing the following action items:') but the list is missing from the extracted text. The earlier mini incident report gave a duration of 3 hours 04 minutes (07:38 to 10:42) and a preliminary root cause of an unexpected spike in traffic from internal backend services; the final report's 3 hours 12 minutes (07:30 to 10:42) was used.
